name: Axioma Crossword
tagline: Distributed Multi-Device Cryptic Crossword Engine & Asynchronous Constraint Studio
description: A globally scalable, multi-device cryptic crossword synthesis and solving studio. Features client-side optimistic execution, AC-3 constraint satisfaction with Landauer search dissipation tracking, an interactive Cryptic Anatomy Dissector, and decoupled asynchronous synthesis worker pools.
ergonomic_goals: Multi-device responsiveness: 2-column desktop cruciverbalist workbench, tablet split-view, and mobile touch interface with custom 26-letter soft keypad.
Zero-latency optimistic local execution: instant client-side keystroke validation with asynchronous delta session synchronization.
Cryptic Anatomy Dissector (L1-004): interactive color-coded parse tree revealing anagrams, containers, charades, and indicators.
Decoupled Asynchronous CSP Synthesis (L1-015_1): CPU-bound backtracking offloaded to isolated background worker queues without blocking web traffic.
Landauer Search Dissipation Ledger (L1-008): real-time bit-erasure calculation comparing AC-3 pruned search entropy vs brute force.
Functorial Reversible History (L1-002): instant Cmd+Z undo/redo and multi-device state reconciliation.
Embedded Generational Feedback: in-app feedback modal funneling solver friction into the G2 learning stream.
